The Moomo brothers save the ship from the scrap heap, agreeing with each other just long enough to purchase the craft. Unbelievably, they add even more weaponry to the ship "just in case" they need it. A few torpedoes are even welded on, just for show (but real nonetheless). Many of the weapons are controlled from the cockpit on their side of the ship, but two turrets are manned. The ship now serves as their base of operation and storehouse for their considerable personal armory.
